verdict.rationale: Lago's own docs describe a built-in AI agent that lets users manage billing by describing what they need in plain language. The Dunning Agent is a first-party agent that handles overdue-invoice chasing, though it hands remaining cases to a person. The evidence is mostly marketing-level, and the MCP server and Agent SDK serve external assistants, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: documentation of which tasks the in-product assistant can perform end-to-end, how it is accessed in the UI, its permissions and approval controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: With our AI agent, you manage billing by describing what you need in plain language. No manual steps, no busywork.
An AR analyst for overdue invoices. It reads each customer's payment history before it chases, and hands the rest to a person.
The Dunning Agent reads the account first: twelve months of invoices and payments, the disputes, the provider status.
